summary: Iteration 103 retest of the iteration-102 action items (backend + frontend). Backend: test_my_tests_journey.py 12/12 passed after the UI fixtures were cleaned up. While the TEST_JR_f8d69ed0 UI fixtures were still present on 9900000196, 4 journey tests failed only because the fixtures overlapped (test interference, not a product bug). test_manual_solve_reports.py 19/19 passed. New tests/test_iter103_regressions.py: 6/7 passed. The receipt fix works: a legacy completed attempt with no receipt now returns 202 with receipt=None instead of 500. Batched catalogue saved flags are per-user and isolated. The group-detail parser returns 404 for invalid version/shape/hash, treats missing or blank source_hash as legacy, and every priorities group_id round-trips. One failure: a report whose source_hash is explicitly null makes GET /studio/question-report-group return 500 (the Pydantic model field is `source_hash: str`). Frontend at 1920x800 and 390x844, using the seeded real attempts: the typography fix is verified (66% gauge Roboto Mono 700 40px, 165 / 250 and 90% at 26px desktop / 22px mobile, child spans inherit, captions Figtree 12px). SetDetail 75/180/300 are a uniform 32px desktop / 24px mobile. The progress chart shows 10 points with 'Mock attempt #', 'Score (marks)' and 'Accuracy (%)' labels plus the caveat. The real-rank view shows the 'Reliable rank estimate unavailable' heading in Figtree, score '175 / 300 on this mock' in mono, a distinct source caption, and the cohort as '—' with a reason (1 profile < 100). Home eyebrows are white at 0.85 opacity and the free pill is centre-aligned with the My Tests button. The Calendar+Popover date filters work: selection gives a URL like start=2026-10-10 and the API request carries start=; to<from shows 'Start date must be before the end date.'; clear works; the keyboard works; nothing overflows at 390. Comparison headings stack as eyebrow/title/date; different papers are rejected; selection clears on tab change. The catalogue page made 0 GET /my/tests/saved/{id} calls; save gives aria-pressed=true and the toast 'Saved to My Tests. No timer started.'; remove works. Studio shows groups 3/2/1 with singular '1 profile'. No horizontal overflow anywhere tested.

minor.issue: A legacy report with explicit source_hash=null gets 500 (pydantic: 'source_hash Input should be a valid string'). The match predicate {'$in':['',None]} finds the doc, but QuestionReport.source_hash: str = '' rejects None. Production currently has 0 such docs, but the claim 'legacy null handled' does not hold. Reproduced by test_iter103_regressions.py::TestReportGroup::test_explicit_null_source_hash_legacy.

issues: The corner copy '01 / CHOOSE YOUR EXAM' wraps onto 2 lines at both 1920 and 390 (max-width:120px in .bold-exam-top>span). It is readable but the brief asked for no wrap.

The X-axis title 'Mock attempt #' sits 1-3px into the Legend's top edge (desktop label bottom 1274 vs legend top 1273; mobile 1630 vs 1627). Visually tight. Add legend paddingTop or raise the XAxis height.
The 'To' popover touches the right viewport edge exactly (x 140 + w 250 = 390). Add collisionPadding of about 8.
Day cells are 32x32px, below the 44px touch-target guideline.
The invalid-range error offers only 'Retry', which re-sends the same invalid range. Offer 'Clear dates' or validate on the client.

A legacy/synthetic summary without an accuracy field shows 'Accuracy unavailable' on the card, while the comparison computes 62.5% for the same attempt. Real attempts carry accuracy, so this is legacy-only.
Cohort note 'cohort rank is shown from 100 profiles' reads awkwardly. Suggest 'shown once 100 comparable profiles exist'.
Studio report rows use en-US dates (10/22/2026, 9:14:05 PM) while the rest of the app uses en-IN ('22 Sept 2026'). Intl en-IN renders 'Sept', not the 'Sep' of d MMM yyyy.

action_items: Make QuestionReport.source_hash tolerate null (e.g. `source_hash: str | None = ''` plus a validator coercing None to ''), or coerce in from_mongo, so legacy null reports don't 500 in group detail or list.
Guard the SetDetail numeric_rule <li> so it renders only when present.

Optional polish: corner copy no-wrap/shorter; legend padding under the 'Mock attempt #' label; Popover collisionPadding plus larger day cells at 390; 'Clear dates' action on the invalid-range error; en-IN date in the Studio report rows.

rca of the issue: Null source_hash 500: report_group builds {'source_hash': {'$in': ['', None]}}, which matches docs with null or missing values. Then QuestionReport.from_mongo validates `source_hash: str = ''`. A missing key falls back to the default, but an explicit None fails validation, raising ValidationError, which surfaces as 500. Repro: insert a report with source_hash=None, then GET /api/studio/question-report-group?group_id=<set>|1|<q>|. Fix: coerce None to '' in the model/validator.
